name: excelsior-desktop
description: Excelsior desktop — Electron shell reusing apps/web frontend over WS hub (pkg/protocol)

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:web" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run copy:web && electron-builder --win --linux
scripts.build:win: npm run build:web && npm run copy:web && electron-builder --win
scripts.pack: npm run build:web && npm run copy:web && electron-builder --dir
